newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet offers FIM 700 mln for Atlas.
newsitem.headline: Valmet offers FIM 700 mln for Atlas.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it was bidding 700 million markka or 86 million sterling for publicly listed British engineering group Atlas Converting Equipment Plc.

"Valmet has made a public offer to aquire Atlas Converting Equipment Plc, a UK company which is listed on the London Stock Exchange, manufacturing slitting and rewinding machines and converting machines," Valmet said.
"The value of the offer is approximately FIM 700 million (86 million pounds)," it said.
"The acquisition will enable ... Valmet ... to market a full range of products to the flexible packaging industry worldwide," it said.
Atlas' main operating facilities are located in Bedford and Heywood, England, and it has around 450 employees, Valmet said.
In 1996, Atlas reported a consolidated profit on ordinary activities before tax of 68 million markka on net sales of 700 million markka.
"This acquisition is in line with our strategy to grow our core businesses and promises to be very fruitful for both companies," Valmet CEO Matti Sundberg said in the statement.
